case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's central location, spectacular city views and rooftop bar, helpful and welcoming staff, spacious/clean rooms and varied breakfasts; some mentioned parking. Negative comments included noisy rooms facing the street or tram, dated or problematic bathrooms, limited electrical sockets/power, TV/remote or channel issues, occasional air-conditioning hiccups, signage/entrance confusion during renovations, and isolated reports of mold or drainage clogs.
